items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore suffered a shoulder injury (AC joint sprain) Thursday night, ruled OUT for TNF vs Lions. Doctors do not consider it serious; day-to-day with a chance but not a lock to play next week vs Chargers.
items.why: Shoulder/AC joint sprain confirmed via sources; X-rays/locker room evaluation during game.
items.implication: Misses TNF; monitor for Week 3 availability. Short-term hit to Bills WR corps and Josh Allen targets.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for remaining Bills WRs in TNF; potential flex upside if prolonged.

items.text: Ladd McConkey DNP second straight day (ribs/chest from Week 1 hit), making it unlikely he plays Sunday vs Raiders. Without him in W1 4th quarter, Johnston and Harris ran 90%+ routes.
items.why: Rib injury; consecutive DNPs; coach day-to-day but practice absence signals low availability.
items.implication: Expect OUT or limited; major downgrade for Week 2.
items.opportunity: Quentin Johnston borderline WR2 upside; Tre Harris boom/bust WR3; Njoku streamer appeal.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP Thursday, second straight missed practice. Ja'Kobi Lane (fractured wrist) on IR/return. If Flowers OUT vs Saints, Ravens WR hierarchy: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated in Week 1; consecutive DNPs; day-to-day but risk rising without Friday practice.
items.implication: Uncertain for Sunday; safer to have backups ready. Andrews target share spikes without him.
items.opportunity: Bateman primary beneficiary for targets/routes; Mark Andrews elevated TE usage.

items.text: Nico Collins hurt hamstring in Wednesday practice (history of hammy issues including 5-game IR in 2024); DNP Thursday, grade 1 strain per reports. Status in jeopardy for Week 2 vs Bengals despite not believed serious. Week 1 routes: Collins 37/42.
items.why: Hamstring strain during practice; MRI/tests; DNP next day; soft-tissue history.
items.implication: High risk of missing Week 2; contingency plans needed. Long-term less concerning if grade 1.
items.opportunity: If OUT, routes/targets to Xavier Hutchinson (29 routes W1), Kayshon Boutte (27), Jaylin Noel.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson says 'I’m ready to go' after missing Week 1 (ankle). Unclear how much he earns vs Rhamondre Stevenson, but timing ideal: Pats desperate for explosives with AJ Brown on IR, strong upcoming matchups (PIT/JAX/BUF etc) before bye.
items.why: Full readiness comments; AJ Brown IR creates playmaker vacuum; favorable schedule.
items.implication: Potential committee or change-of-pace with upside; monitor snap/route share.
items.opportunity: Explosive carries/routes/targets in pass-heavy or trailing scripts; handcuff value rises.

items.text: Brock Bowers DNP again Thursday due to last week's knee (meniscus) surgery; has yet to practice since. Unlikely for Week 2 vs Chargers.
items.why: Post-surgery; zero practice participation this week.
items.implication: Miss Week 2; Michael Mayer fringe TE1/stream.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE Week 2 vs IND: 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 24% target share (tied team lead, 2nd-highest career), 40% targets/routes. IND allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. RB1 overall in range of outcomes if healthy.
items.why: Elite Week 1 utilization (touches, targets, snaps); smash matchup vs porous IND run D.
items.implication: Must-start, high-upside RB1; massive season potential.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE @ LAC: Utilization Score 99 in Week 1 (tied Bijan for lead). 19% target share recent; 25+ touches in 3 of last 4. Overreaction to prior injury scare.
items.why: Elite utilization/usage in debut under Kubiak; high target share history.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with upside; trust the role.
items.opportunity: Near-every-down back potential with receiving work.

items.text: ETR Week 2 waiver injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; AJ Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller. Streaming options include those plus others.
items.why: Direct injury replacements with available waiver status and projected role expansion.
items.implication: Priority adds for depth/handcuffs in impacted backfields/WR rooms.
items.opportunity: Immediate snap/route/target spikes for listed beneficiaries.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE vs CLE: Career-high 26% target share, 8 more routes than Gainwell, all RB red-zone touches. CLE allowed 121 rush yds/4.8 YPC. RB9 utilization.
items.why: Expanded receiving/red-zone role vs Gainwell; favorable matchup.

items.text: Justin Jefferson LOVE @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz in W1; 93 rec yds/18 PPG avg in 6 career games with Wentz. CHI D allowed 10+ YPT to CAR WRs.
items.why: Massive target share; proven chemistry with Wentz; soft secondary matchup.

items.text: DeVonta Smith LOVE @ TEN: 27% target share, 13.7 aDOT (3 deep looks) in W1. TEN allowed 85% catch rate/16 YPR to Jets WRs; 6th-most PPG to WRs since last year.
items.why: Strong usage rebound spot; exploitable TEN secondary.

items.text: Travis Etienne HATE @ BAL: Matched Kendre Miller rush attempts W1, 69% fantasy pts via air. Kamara expected back squeezes role further; NO 8.5-pt underdogs not run-friendly script.
items.why: Committee with Miller; Kamara return imminent; negative game script vs BAL.
items.opportunity: Reduced carries if Kamara active; passing-game only.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. HATE vs SEA: Only 8% target share W1 (5th on team), zero red-zone looks. SEA 3rd-fewest PPG to WRs since last season.
items.why: Abysmal target share; tough matchup vs SEA secondary.
